hypothesis: Daily label grading suppresses irrelevant fine rank differences while preserving or improving predictive usefulness; robustness and return are assessed separately.
user_idea: 标签分级实验：等样本、等涨幅、两头少中间多，并尝试不同n。
user_control_choice: 沿用最近 H20／patience50 对照

candidates.method: fixed daily percentile boundaries 20/40/60/80; retain ties
fixed daily percentile boundaries10..90; retain ties
raw daily H20 minimum..maximum equally spaced into5 intervals; no winsorization; edge belongs to lower interval
fixed daily percentile boundaries5/20/80/95; mass5/15/60/15/5; retain ties

encoding: Ordinal bin ID 0..n-1; one affine transform fitted on reference training rows only matches mean/std of continuous control training labels. Same frozen transform for old-label sensitivity; no CSRankNorm or daily reranking after grading.
sample_protocol: Exact H20 training indices, original rank-before-date-selection and legacy-h40-base-v1; no sample/intersection changes.
evaluation: Canonical official_head_from_preds; five-seed daily zscore mean, Top3xH5 net_ann/net_ann_vol/net_sharpe, globalH5RankIC, years/styles; retain individual seeds as diagnostics.
sensitivity: For quantile5/quantile10/tails5 run all5 seeds on both new/old label treatments unless encoded float32 inputs are identical. Width5 lacks frozen old raw-return magnitudes; report that106-change paired sensitivity is unavailable, do not synthesize old returns.
diagnostics: full early-stop curves and tree counts
Top3/Top5 tie frequency and seed agreement
paired old/new heads and metric differences on common frozen inputs
decision_rule: No single automatic pass threshold or promotion. Compare all4 primary candidates to same-source continuous H20; report return,volatility,Sharpe,RankIC separately. Robustness improvement alone is insufficient. Historical selection window, no independent OOS claim.
entry_policy: One new label-grading study; four internal scientific candidates and two sensitivity treatments retain separate identities/results/costs. Native harness parent lifecycle+fit ledger, supplemental internal-candidate ledger; native variant count is not the scientific count.
implementation: Task-local adapters call existing trainer, evaluator, registry and report; no new permanent module or platform structure.
